item.title: Truck Fire Days After Brake Repair Leads to Lawsuit
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — Three trucking companies are suing Bruckner Truck Sales Inc. in Tom Green County district court, alleging a brake repair performed in September 2017 led to a fiery crash just five days later that destroyed a tractor, trailer and cargo. Reefer Carrier LLC, Special Transport LLC, and SSR Trucking LLC filed the suit in 2021 in the 51st District Court as Cause No. A210335C, claiming Bruckner breached contract and the implied warranty of good and workmanlike repair. Learn More Here.

item.title: Angelo State's Ryan Named the LSC's Defensive Player of the Week
item.description: RICHARDSON, TX — Angelo State junior forward Jhordan Ryan has been named the Lone Star Conference Defensive Player of the Week, the league announced Tuesday, following standout performances against Western New Mexico and Sul Ross State.Ryan anchored a Rams defense that held the Mustangs and Lobos to a combined 33.9% shooting from the field and limited the two teams to an average of 51.5 points per game. Learn More Here.

item.title: Fort Worth ISD Loses Appeal, Will be Taken Over by Texas Education Agency
item.description: FORT WORTH, TX — A judge denied Fort Worth ISD's appeal Friday to avoid being taken over by the Texas Education Agency.A state administrative court concluded no factual disputes would justify overturning Commissioner Mike Morath’s decision to intervene in the 70,000-student district because of failing academics. This clears the way for Morath to install new leadership over the city’s largest school system. Learn More Here.

item.title: Man Wanted for ATM Theft Arrested in Tom Green County
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — A 25-year-old fugitive wanted in Georgia on a felony burglary charge waived extradition in Tom Green County District Court last week, court records show. Felix Fendon-Garcia, 25, signed a waiver of extradition Feb. 4, consenting to return to Georgia with law enforcement officers from that state. item.title: Texas Rangers Investigating Fatal Shooting That Left 5 Dead
item.description: HALE COUNTY, TX — The Texas Rangers are investigating a fatal shooting that left five adults dead early Saturday morning in the Seth Ward neighborhood just outside Plainview, authorities said.According to the Texas Department of Public Safety, the Hale County Sheriff’s Office requested assistance from the Texas Rangers at approximately 3:40 a.m. Saturday, after a shooting was reported in the 2700 block of Upchurch. item.title: XOXO, Downtown Stroll to be Held in San Angelo on Thursday
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — Downtown San Angelo, Inc. is inviting the community to the XOXO, Downtown Stroll from 5 p.m. to 8 p.m. Thursday.The event is described as a “fun-filled girls’ night celebrating friendship, shopping local, and all things downtown.”The tour is a self-guided event where guests can stroll through participating downtown businesses, enjoy exclusive specials, sip themed drinks, and take part in a selfie scavenger hunt throughout the district.
